spec: Create a reusable human-supervised pair of GPT Build and Audit agents that produce complete, evidence-based, adversarially tested GPT design packages.
acceptance_criteria: The Builder produces a complete GPT package with a behavior contract, configuration, instructions, capability limits, Knowledge and Action boundaries, evals, and a valid v2 handoff.
The Auditor independently reviews complete current artifacts, maps every criterion to evidence, and reports supported findings without inventing a defect quota.
The loop preserves current snapshots and finding IDs across at most three audit rounds, with final human escalation after audit 3.
The pair explicitly handles prompt injection, secrets, privacy, uncertainty, unsupported capabilities, tool failure, and live-verification limits.
The retained v2 examples and protocol validator pass, while a live Custom GPT test is honestly marked unavailable.

artifacts.summary: GPT-specific Builder instructions with complete artifact snapshots, capability matrix, eval plan, and bounded rework.
Independent GPT Auditor instructions with adversarial coverage for tools, Knowledge, privacy, injection, and output contracts.
Setup, workflow, limits, and self-application record.
Adds the GPT design profile while preserving protocol v2.
GPT-specific names, starters, capability defaults, and Knowledge files.
GPT platform, Knowledge, Action, safety, evaluation, and maintenance standards.
GPT-specific kickoff, audit, rework, and escalation packet templates.
GPT-specific calibration, injection, capability, and round-accounting checks.

context_manifest.purpose: Normative shared handoff and audit rules.
Project-specific GPT standards; template supplied, completed project file unavailable.

verification.check: Retained upstream examples and protocol chain
verification.evidence: Validator output: Validated 6 bundled examples and 4 expected-rejection fixtures against Draft 2020-12 schemas and protocol cross-field rules.

verification.check: Static self-audit of Builder and Auditor prompts
verification.command: Manual inspection against GPT-specific acceptance criteria
verification.evidence: Each criterion was traced to the final prompt, contract, configuration, templates, or smoke test.

verification.check: Live Custom GPT behavior and editor capability verification
verification.command: Configure and exercise both GPTs in the target platform
verification.evidence: No live Custom GPT instance or target-platform execution environment was supplied.

self_audit.note: Upstream code-oriented workflow was generalized to GPT design artifacts and platform capability limits.
The pair was statically reviewed; live GPT behavior, editor labels, and platform features remain unverified.
Existing v2 schemas and validator were retained rather than replaced.

assumptions: The target use is two private Custom GPTs operated by a human who manually transfers complete packets between them.
flags: Complete project standards must be filled in before a real task.
A model PASS is not live-platform or production approval.
open_questions: Which target platform plan and editor capabilities will be used in production?
What project-specific safety, data-retention, and release standards should be added to standards.md?
